sessions.summary: Set up ARI Vivo (vertical pace). Ingested the Vivo B2C Atendimento ROM (199 stories, 10 domains, 27-person/5-squad build, ~12.4k-29.8k productive hrs) as the primary grounding doc; ran full extraction audit (mostly Confirmed). Intent clarified: revalidate the ROM and produce a COMPLETE Salesforce PS project plan + role/hours estimate spanning all methodology phases, since the ROM prices Build/Delivery only.

decisions.decision: ROM = Build/Delivery anchor only; wrap full PS lifecycle (P&D + SIT/UAT/Deploy/Scale + governance) around it
decisions.rationale: ROM explicitly excludes PM/governance and non-build phases; scoper needs complete profile+hours estimate. Recorded as decisions/0001.
